host_about:
Hi, I like to work hard and play hard.  I multi-task and am engaged in many productive endeavors at any one time, but I also love to party and meet friends. name: A Kool Room
description: Vacationing or travelling for business to Belmopan, the capital of Belize? Then, our move-in ready apartment is perfect for you; it is a sort of studio apartment with a private bathroom.  The apartment accommodates 2 persons in 2 double beds.  Travelling in a bigger group?  Then we can accommodate up to 3 persons more with a second adjoining room (can be booked separately).
neighborhood_overview: I am happy to assure you, you can have live comfortably and interestingly in Belmopan.  This area has a multi-ethnic population, comprised of the Creole, Garifuna, Maya, Central American Mestizo, Chinese, Taiwanese, Indian, North-Americans, and many Europeans. A lot of the expats work with the many embassies and consulates, and have an active community and social life in Belmopan.  As home to the University of Belize, seat of government and location of several embassies and consulates, Belmopan receives a lot of commuting workers on a daily basis.
host_about:
Hi, I like to work hard and play hard.  I multi-task and am engaged in many productive endeavors at any one time, but I also love to party and meet friends.  I enjoy reading for pleasure...not too serious material, and learning new languages.  I love to have intellectual discussion and debate...and I like swimming.

As your host, I will basically leave you your space, but am easily reachable for any questions or assistance you may need.  I like to provide an initial introduction to places, activities, and people in the immediate environment, so that you feel comfortable of your surroundings as soon as possible.  Because I work full time I am honest about the time when I can be available on any given day.

When I myself travel, I love to do so by road whenever possible and by staying at more basic accommodations, because I think that's when you best get to KNOW the people and place you visit.  I also like to have a fixed base and make day trips...something that is quite possible living in Belmopan, as it is in the center of the small but beautiful country of Belize.

It would be great if you choose to visit Belmopan, Belize, as the people and the country are multi-cultural, interesting, friendly and helpful.  I wish that someday you decide to grace us with a visit.

name: #12 Gran Mestizo Premium Riverside Cabin
description:
Breakfast for 3 persons included in rate.

In the northern district of Orange Walk, we are midway between Belize City and the border city of Chetumal, Mexico to the north (one hour drive in either direction). Our property is Gold Standard Approved for your health and safety.

Open walls & semi private bedrooms; an 8 minute drive from Orange Walk Town. Cabin #11 is part of a 2 story duplex. Kitchen, breakfast bar, living room, loft, large porch. 1 queen bed, 1 double bed, 1 futon
neighborhood_overview:
Orange Walk is a true feel of small town Northern Belize. If you're coming in from Belize City, look out for the sugar factory at the entrance of the town (you'll see two smoke stacks on your right hand side). Acres and acres of cane fields line the highways and villages surrounding Orange Walk. We are also home to 2 of the 3 rum distilleries in Belize. An 8-minute drive will take you to the center of town. The street leading to the market is blocked off for pedestrians on Saturday mornings. Take a stroll and buy some fresh fruit.

Orange Walk is not one of the traditional tourist destinations in Belize. Come here for Mayan Temples, culture, Mestizo cuisine, rum, and friendly people.

If you like adventure, we offer tour of Lamanai Archaeological Site that depart from the riverside deck on the property. More info about this in the "other things to note" section.

....Or you can relax and do nothing. If you don't want to leave the property, Marac
host_about:
We should die with memories…not dreams

"Don't be satisfied with stories, how things have gone with others. Unfold your own myth.” 
― Rumi

neighborhood_overview:

The Belizean jungle is filled with life and our home happens to be in the middle of the jungle. During your stay you will have access to over a mile of forest trails, an outdoor kitchen with a wood fire stove, and all the seasonal fruits that you wish to try.

description: Our little Casita is a short 5 min drive from the heart of San Ignacio and nestled umungst the native land scape of the rainforest. neighborhood_overview: Our neighborhood is small, we live at the top of the hill and have three neighbors that are local. Very private, very safe and we love it. If your staying July, Aug, Sep, enjoy two very high producing Avocado trees. Jun, July, and Aug, enjoy native fruit of our mango trees. We also have a Bread fruit tree, Feb,March, April, and May. They are used like potatoes, boil, bake or fry!!! Two huge almond trees that produce all year long. A tamarin fruit tree, Nov, Dec, and Jan. They are pod looking, eat, or make fresh Tamarin juice. Coconut trees and one banana tree. Also go pick leafs off the all spice tree, boil in pot and the smell is amazing and drink as tea!
host_about:
Hello, We are Rose and Nancy Vella, we are natives to Sonoma County California. We have known each other since 1977, and got legally married January 18, 2015 at our beautiful Bodega Head, with our 4 closest friends. We had our big wedding 5/15/15 for our family and friends. Rose bought our Belize home in 2011, as an investment and a retirement get away. We are both lovers of travel, traveling in our trailer, camping, going to SF Giants games, going to concerts, and old cars. Rose has been to Europe twice to spend time with her family in Malta. She has also traveled around Italy, Greece, Canada, England, Hawaii, Mexico,Belize, Costa Rica, and the caribbean.
Not to mention various places with in the US.  I'v been to Mexico, Hawaii and Belize. We own two 55 Chevy's and are avid car show participants. Rose drove me to school my sophomore year everyday in that car and we of course had some of or favorite wedding photos taken in our yellow and white 55. 
We take care of my 83 year old dad, nicknamed DADDY-O. So when we need some much needed time away, well you know where we head...... Thats right 
our lovey little casita in San Ignacio Belize. 
Roses motto is " Do It Once, Do It Right" 
So that's how she lives her life!
As for me..... Well my motto is " Everyday Is A Good Day, Some Are Just Better Than Others"

description: Leslie's Private Paradise offers three separate, self-contained hardwood cabins and a family-sized swimming pool on the fringe of a lush tropical rainforest in  the village of Teakettle, just minutes away from Belmopan, the capital City of Belize, and a half hour drive to San Ignacio, for dining and visits to ancient Maya archaeological sites. host_about: I am a retired diplomat and former senior officer in the Government of Belize. I enjoy nature and the quiet serenity of the rainforest. I also love people, great music, great conversations and great movies. I have travelled all over the world in my capacity as Ambassador, and have met many interesting people with whom I still keep in contact. My wife, Bernadette, and I are very open-minded and treat our guests as friends and kin. Retirement from diplomacy meant a new direction, so we chose to build three cottages and open our private retreat to paying guests, which would keep us in contact with people from all over the world. We love it here. We are happy to have you join us in a welcoming, uncomplicated environment where warmth and friendship await you. The longer you stay, the happier we all are. We particularly like to host persons who are on short or long-term consultancies in the Belmopan area; newlyweds looking for a honeymoon getaway, couples with young families, or adventurous grown-ups who use our place as a base for forays into rock-climbing, zip-lining, cave-tubing, rainforest hiking or ancient Maya site explorations; also retired couples who just want a quiet place to refresh the soul. You are all welcome.

'Follow your heart'

 Mary is a village girl and we started a family in 2012. She can make baskets and cook on a fire hearth. She also likes to do nails, dress up, yet has a wealth of information from living off the land.

Thanks for the consideration of Faith's Farm.

host_about:
We’re Brian and Brenda Montgomery – Manatee Villa is our dream home and we’re delighted to be able to share it with you.

The story of our Villa has been a long time in the making. In fact, it goes all the way back to 2003, when Brian received a life-changing diagnosis. 
 
When you learn you have Stage 4 cancer and are given just six months to live, you begin to reflect on the things that are important to you.

For us it was family and loved ones first and foremost – and the wonderful experiences we could share together.

It was during that trying time when the idea of a beachside retreat came to us. But our dream seemed just that – a dream.

Brian was undergoing treatment, and we were fighting with all that we had to hold on to him.

One evening, with the lyrics of the Beach Boys’ Kokomo washing over us, we made a bold decision. We’d fight through this, and when Brian was well enough, we’d begin exploring the beauty of the Caribbean.

That day finally came, and we were off to Jamaica and then Aruba shortly thereafter.

Years passed, and life intervened, but that dream was always in front of us.

Then one year our travels took us to the stunning beaches of Placencia, Belize.

With its perfect weather, gorgeous setting and wonderful people, Placencia captured our hearts like nowhere else. We knew we’d found the setting for our Villa.

name: Beachfront guest suite w/private bath. "Seafish"
description:
Three purpose built guest rooms downstairs from my home. They share a veranda with two hammocks for each room. Seafish is the middle room. We are located on a lovely beach with shady palms - in the Garifuna fishing village of Hopkins.
Hopkins is a village that gives you access to kayaking, snorkeling, diving the barrier reef, jungle treks, and Mayan ruins.
Open your room door. Step right out onto the beach. Step into the Caribbean sea.
neighborhood_overview: We are right on the beach! We are in the village of Hopkins, which is part of the charm I think, but I also know that it is not what everybody is looking for. Hopkins is still very much a village community, not a resort tourist destination, but it is a wonderful community with a unique Garifuna culture. Come to Hopkins with that in mind, embrace a different land and culture, and you will love it. If you are looking for a resort style vacation, then we may not be the right place for you. Being in the village can sometimes mean you will hear children, dogs, music, chicken and roosters, but mostly you will hear the breeze through the palm trees and the sound of the waves.
host_about:
I am the owner and manager of a guesthouse in Hopkins since 1998 and I've managed AJ Palms Apartments since 2014. 
I'm British by birth, and naturalized Belizean by choice. 

I lived in Germany, off and on, for 10 years before moving to Belize. I am fairly good at speaking German, not all that great at writing it - but I am willing to try. 

I've always felt renting out my rooms and apartments is like renting out a part of my home, hopefully my guests get to feel the same way when they I host them.

I'm enjoying my life on the beach.

Come to Hopkins with that in mind, embrace a different land and culture, and you will love it. If you are looking for a resort style vacation, then we may not be the right place for you. Being in the village can sometimes mean you will hear children, dogs, music, radios, chicken and roosters, but mostly you will hear the breeze through the palm trees and the sound of the waves.
host_about:
I am the owner and manager of a guesthouse in Hopkins since 1998 and I've managed AJ Palms Apartments since 2014. 
I'm British by birth, and naturalized Belizean by choice. 

I lived in Germany, off and on, for 10 years before moving to Belize. I am fairly good at speaking German, not all that great at writing it - but I am willing to try. 

I've always felt renting out my rooms and apartments is like renting out a part of my home, hopefully my guests get to feel the same way when they I host them.

I'm enjoying my life on the beach.

The Cayo District
Belize has a lot to offer to travelers, and the Cayo District in Western Belize is ground zero if you want to make the most of your time here. Guatemala is just a stone’s throw away, but you could stay for months without having to cross over the border to find new things to do.

Cayo used to be the beating heart of the Maya civilization in Belize, and that means that there are still plenty of well-preserved ruins to explore. The same qualities that made Cayo such fertile territory for the Mayas also makes it an ideal location to live, work, and play.

description:
Three purpose built guest rooms downstairs from my home. They share a veranda with two hammocks for each room. Seashell is an end room. We are located on a lovely beach with shady palms - in the Garifuna fishing village of Hopkins.
Hopkins is a village that gives you access to kayaking, snorkeling, diving the barrier reef, jungle treks, and Mayan ruins.
Open your room door. Step right out onto the beach. Step into the Caribbean sea.
neighborhood_overview: We are right on the beach! We are in the village of Hopkins, which is part of the charm I think, but I also know that it is not what everybody is looking for. Hopkins is still very much a village community, not a resort tourist destination, but it is a wonderful community with a unique Garifuna culture. Come to Hopkins with that in mind, embrace a different land and culture, and you will love it. If you are looking for a resort style vacation, then we may not be the right place for you. Being in the village can sometimes mean you will hear children, dogs, music, radios, chicken and roosters, but mostly you will hear the breeze through the palm trees and the sound of the waves.
host_about:
I am the owner and manager of a guesthouse in Hopkins since 1998 and I've managed AJ Palms Apartments since 2014. 
I'm British by birth, and naturalized Belizean by choice. 

I lived in Germany, off and on, for 10 years before moving to Belize. I am fairly good at speaking German, not all that great at writing it - but I am willing to try. 

I've always felt renting out my rooms and apartments is like renting out a part of my home, hopefully my guests get to feel the same way when they I host them.

I'm enjoying my life on the beach.

neighborhood_overview:
Orange Walk is a true feel of small town Northern Belize. If you're coming in from Belize City, look out for the sugar factory at the entrance of the town (you'll see two smoke stacks on your right hand side). Acres and acres of cane fields line the highways and villages surrounding Orange Walk. We are also home to 2 of the 3 rum distilleries in Belize. An 8-minute drive will take you to the center of town. The street leading to the market is blocked off for pedestrians on Saturday mornings. Take a stroll and buy some fresh fruit.

Orange Walk is not one of the traditional tourist destinations in Belize. Come here for Mayan Temples, culture, Mestizo cuisine, rum, and friendly people.

If you like adventure, we offer tour of Lamanai Archaeological Site that depart from the riverside deck on the property. More info about this in the "other things to note" section.

....Or you can relax and do nothing. If you don't want to leave the property, Marac
host_about:
We should die with memories…not dreams

neighborhood_overview:
Eden Farm's many tropical fruit trees include: Jamaica Lime, soursop, avocado, banana, orange, tamarind, breadfruit, cashew, coconut, starfruit, mango and grapefruit, among many.
Howler monkeys are sometimes heard just off the property.
The farm abuts Elijio Panti Medicinal Reserve, which can be accessed via San Antonio village, with a local guide.
San Antonio village is a close-knit, friendly Yucatec Mayan village, which is renowned for healers and artists. The village has 2 small stores, a bakery, several restaurants and takeaways, and 7 churches.
There is a Mayan site called Pacbitun, a short distance beyond the farm.

neighborhood_overview:
The Great House Inn is located in the historic Fort George Area: The Fort George area, a peninsula ringed by Marine Parade Boulevard and Fort Street, is one of the most pleasant in Belize City. Meander in the neighborhood and you’ll pass some impressive homes and buildings, including The Great House Inn now the only colonial guest house. The Baron Bliss Memorial and Fort George Lighthouse stand guard over it all. Towering over the coastline and facing the Belize Harbor, the Fort George Lighthouse was built as part of the memorial for Baron Bliss, Belize’s greatest benefactor. In fulfillment of his dying wish and financed with the generous proceeds he left the country, the tall structure was erected next to his tomb and memorial. While the public cannot enter the lighthouse, it remains an important, historic landmark in Belize City and is easy to spot while touring the Fort George area. The views from there also make for a nice photo op.

host_about:
I am Virginia Krohn and I am not only the owner of Villa Cayo but I designed, drew the plans for and built the villas.  I am also a real estate broker and the owner of Belize Live-Retire-Invest  which is myself and a group of expats dedicated to helping other people relocate to Belize. 


Originally from Texas I am a sculptor, painter and a custom home builder who knows how to pay attention to detail.   After visiting Belize in the '80s my husband and I returned to the states, sold our home and business and relocated to Belize in 1991.  Living on the beach for almost 20 years just 60' from that beautiful teal water was magical.  As the island changed the magic did disappear and the new dream became building a luxury Eco-resort in the jungle.

 

One of the best things I like about Belize is that I can afford to have someone help run our business,  have a housekeeper and a gardener which allows me the time to do the creative things I want to do while providing jobs for talented Belizeans.  Belize is not for everyone and it is only what you make of it.

neighborhood_overview: Cayo is a district in western Belize with many parks and ecological reserves. Once the heart of the Belizean Maya world, it's rich with pre-Columbian archaeological sites. neighborhood_overview: Some of the best ruins of Maya cities are located in Cayo District near our home, LUCINA's. LUCINA's is an ideal location for a variety of day trip options. Xunantunich maya ruins features an enormous pyramid temple soaring high above the jungle floor and is about 15 minute drive from our home. The ruins of Cahal Pech (a 5 minute drive away), once the home to Maya elites, lies on a gorgeous setting overlooking the Macal River. description: Thank you for choosing the bungalow at Turtle Beach on beautiful Ambergris Caye as your Caribbean vacation destination! The Barrier reef, biggest in the western hemisphere, shields the island and is just offshore. The private serenity of our property is sure to encompass every adventure in and out of the water you desire, such as: fishing, diving, and marine wildlife watching. We offer a more event based experience as that is what you come to Ambergris to do, enjoy your surroundings.
neighborhood_overview:

host_about: Director of Palmento Grove Garifuna Eco-Cultural & Fishing Institute, Located on the north side of Hopkins Village in southeastern Belize, Palmento Grove Garifuna Eco-Cultural and Fishing Institute consists of both a private island retreat and an inland Tour & Travel Services Business designed to reflect the authenticity of a traditional Garifuna village. Owned and operated by local Garifuna people, an Afro-Caribbean culture indigenous to Belize, Palmento Grove is one of the best places to experience authentic local culture in Belize.For more than 10 years, Palmento Grove Garifuna Eco-Cultural and Fishing Institute has served as a sustainable tourism business and a cultural preservation center. Situated amongst beautiful mangrove bushes on the edge of Fresh Water Creek Lagoon where it meets the Caribbean Sea, Palmento Grove feels like a world away. Specializing in authentic Garifuna cuisine and cultural activities, the institute serves as an outstanding introduction to Garifuna history and culture. Guests of Palmento Grove can wander the footpaths on this isolated strip of island or head out with local fishermen to try your luck at catching some of the many abundant species of fish and seafood that thrive in the area. Guests can use fresh-caught fish mixed with fresh vegetables from the gardens to learn how to cook mouthwatering traditional dishes like hudut, a Garifuna fish stew made with coconuts and plantains, all accompanied by the sounds of traditional Garifuna drumming. Designed to promote holistic healing and rejuvenation, Palmento Grove is a true sanctuary where guests are surrounded on all sides by fresh air and delightful scenery. Rooms at Palmento Grove are cozy and comfortable, furnished in the traditional Garifuna style, and with magnificent views looking out at the pristine garden & water view. Palmento Grove is an environmental and socially conscious business that is dedicated to empowering people through the promotion and preservation of traditional cultural knowledge, history, and way of life. Palmento Grove Garifuna Eco-Cultural & Fishing Institute is also the organizer of the Belize Paranda MusicFest, which promotes and protects traditional Garifuna Music in Belize as well as sponsoring an annual cultural and entrepreneurial summer camp for local youths. If you're looking for an oasis away from the stresses and strains of modern life, then Palmento Grove Garifuna Eco-Cultural & Fishing Institute is exactly the place that you've been looking for. Palmento also organizes tours to nearby attractions on the reef and mainland, including snorkeling, scuba diving, and trips to ancient Maya cities. The Institute can be reached from Belize City in about two and a half hours and is located in the historic Commerce Bight area on the north side of Hopkins Village in Stann Creek District. For a truly authentic Belizean experience, choose Palmento Grove Garifuna Eco-Cultural and Fishing Institute.

They are open for lunch and dinner (every day of the week) and focus more on seafood. They have live music most evenings as well. Underneath 303 Belize, is Elite Adventures, a dive and snorkel shop.
Just south of our property is the Farmhouse Market and Cafe. They offer a wide selection of fresh coffees, juices/smoothies,

Nikki & Jerry are a husband and wife team, founders of Belize Bird Rescue and owners of Rock Farm 50 acre reserve. We have been in Belize since 2003 and fell into bird rescue entirely by accident. Rock Farm Guest House generates sustainable income to keep the rescue funded. Staying with us in our home will make you feel warm and fuzzy all over as, not only will you enjoy a beautiful property, you will be helping us to save the birds!
We operate a home-from-home with lovely rooms and great home cooking. We have 50 acres of fabulous grounds for you to explore, and a crystal-clear river to swim in.
Please note that we don't have AC or TV in the rooms and there are dogs on the property and the parrots are very loud in the morning!

neighborhood_overview: Teakettle is a rural/farming village. just minutes away from the capital city. Those who are not farmers commute to Belmopan for work and other government business. Teakettle is known for the spectacular and well-preserved Maya cave system Actun Tunicil Maknal (ATM) which contains centuries-old skeletons, ceramics and other Maya objects. Other Maya archaeological sites like Cahal Pech and Xunantunich are less than an hour's drive.
host_about: I am a retired diplomat and former senior officer in the Government of Belize. I enjoy nature and the quiet serenity of the rainforest. I also love people, great music, great conversations and great movies. I have travelled all over the world in my capacity as Ambassador, and have met many interesting people with whom I still keep in contact. My wife, Bernadette, and I are very open-minded and treat our guests as friends and kin. Retirement from diplomacy meant a new direction, so we chose to build three cottages and open our private retreat to paying guests, which would keep us in contact with people from all over the world. We love it here. We are happy to have you join us in a welcoming, uncomplicated environment where warmth and friendship await you. The longer you stay, the happier we all are. We particularly like to host persons who are on short or long-term consultancies in the Belmopan area; newlyweds looking for a honeymoon getaway, couples with young families, or adventurous grown-ups who use our place as a base for forays into rock-climbing, zip-lining, cave-tubing, rainforest hiking or ancient Maya site explorations; also retired couples who just want a quiet place to refresh the soul. You are all welcome.

name: The Sundial Beach Cabana
description:
Welcome to The Sundial Beach Cabana, a private beach house located in Sittee Point. The Sundial Beach Cabana sits directly on the Caribbean sea between the sleepy little fishing village of Hopkins and the Sittee River. It is near all amenities such as restaurants, grocery stores, pharmacy, scuba diving shops and local outfitters. All are easily accessible by bicycle if you choose to not rent a car.
The house faces to the east allowing for amazing sunrises.
neighborhood_overview:
The Sundial Beach Cabana is in a quiet residential neighborhood, about 3 kilometers from the south end of Hopkins village.
Sitting half way down the coast line, many of the major tourist attractions are just a day trip away. A 40 minute boat ride will take you out to the largest barrier reef in the western hemisphere and over 400 pristine Cayes. The scuba diving and snorkeling are exceptional with Belize’s abundance of sea life along with some of the top dive sites in the world. On the mainland explore Mayan ruins, hike in the jungle and take a refreshing dip in the jungle’s infamous Blue Hole off the Hummingbird highway. Tube through caves, catch a zipline, or learn drumming from a local Garifuna drummer.
host_about:
Hi, 
We are Caroline & Jesse. We first visited Belize back in 2005 and fell in love with this small yet diverse country. In 2018, we took the plunge and bought the Sundial Beach Cabana, our home away from home. We try and spend as much time as possible there, but when we can't, we hope to share our love for Belize with others. We hope we get to host you.

We moved to Belize in 2017 from New Jersey to enjoy year-round sun, sea, and warm weather. name: The Teakettle Villa With A View
description:
Right on the Western Highway, perched atop a hill overlooking the small village of Teakettle, the Teakettle Villa allows you to enjoy a 360-degree, majestic view of the Mayan mountain range and the surrounding rain forest from its rooftop deck. This brand new, modern home, allows you to experience the sounds of Howler monkeys and hundreds of species of tropical birds.

The Teakettle Villa is only 6 mi (or 10 km) South-West of Belmopan, Belize’s Capital City where the U.S. Embassy is located.
neighborhood_overview: The Teakettle Villa is your home-away-from-home in Belize. It is within walking distance to the center of Teakettle Village. You can spend your days at nearby Mayan archaeological sites, the Mountain Pine Ridge Forest Reserve where there are water falls, trails and hiking.  Within hiking distance is the TKO Farms, a 912-acre exotic hardwood and citrus tree farm made up of towering Teak, Mahogany, Spanish cedar and Zircote trees. The Teakettle Villa is only 7 miles from Actun Tunichil Mukal (ATM), the most popular Mayan burial site in Western Belize. Directly east on the Western Highway is the Belize Zoo. There is canoeing and kayaking on the Belize River, only half a mile away.  Spend your evenings relaxing on the rooftop deck watching the sun set over the Mayan Mountain range, and wake-up to the sounds of the howling monkeys.

description: Ground floor 1 Bedroom apartment perfect for a comfortable extended stay.  King size bed.  Full size appliances in complete kitchen. Convertible sofa sleeps an additional guest.  Cold AC throughout.  Large, covered, screened patio for eating & entertaining. Ideal location: 3 minute walk to the famous Sidewalk and Sea. neighborhood_overview:
Driftwood Gardens Guesthouse is located towards the top of village in a super convenient location, but set back from the main road so there is still some peace and tranquility.
The village is entirely walkable from the house (we don't own a car or golf cart). The lagoon is less than 30 second walk from the back of the house, and you can be at the beach with just 3 minute walk across the street.
host_about:
We moved to Belize in 2017 from New Jersey to enjoy year-round sun, sea, and warm weather. After years of research and reconnaissance, working multiple jobs and saving as much as possible, we finally dropped our old life, quit those jobs, and moved to Belize.  We chose Placencia as our paradise, and bought this guesthouse within weeks of arriving.  Since then we have enjoyed adapting to the “Barefoot Perfect” lifestyle of the village. We love living in this warm community full of friendly faces and being within walking distance of everywhere we need to go.

Phil’s passion is health and fitness and appreciates being active outdoors year-round. While enjoying all the perks that Belize offers, he has not totally abandoned his prior career path and still works remotely as a physical therapist. 

Megan dabbles in real estate, indulges her creative side by writing a blog (Real Life Recess) and crafting, and is also a superb source of information on expat life, village happenings,  and unique experiences.

We live onsite on the top floor of the guesthouse. We are always available to answer questions, assist with recommendations, and ensure your stay is as relaxing and memorable as possible . Please feel free to approach us at any time!

description: Welcome to your private slice of paradise on northern Ambergris Caye, Belize! I am Virginia Krohn and I am not only the owner of Villa Cayo but I designed, drew the plans for and built the villas.  I am also a real estate broker and the owner of Belize Live-Retire-Invest  which is myself and a group of expats dedicated to helping other people relocate to Belize.

After visiting Belize in the '80s my husband and I returned to the states, sold our home and business and relocated to Belize in 1991. As the island changed the magic did disappear and the new dream became building a luxury Eco-resort in the jungle.

Belize is not for everyone and it is only what you make of it.

name: PUR Boutique Cabana/Crocodile/Adult Only/San Pedro
description: Stay at the only adults-only, boutique cabana experience in Ambergris Caye! PUR Boutique Cabanas offers a modern yet vintage, rustic-luxury experience, with a Taco Bar & swim up pool bar, in the BEST neighborhood in Ambergris Caye, a mile north of the bridge. We offer amenities of a boutique hotel including complimentary airport or water taxi pick up (one round trip), complimentary coffee and water, bathrobes, beach towels, onsite concierge, complimentary bikes, welcome drink, king units & more!
neighborhood_overview:
If it is your first time on the island (the 2013 & 2014 #1 island in the world!) - please note - the water in San Pedro is some of the prettiest water in the world, with perfect white sand, but because it is an island, the shore takes a beating from the sea, and much of the beachfront is sea walled. Because we are close to the reef, there can be seagrass that washes in. However - the swimmable beaches we have - are gorgeous. All beaches in Belize are public, so you are welcome to walk freely on all the beachfront. Although many resorts are located on the beach, there are only a few spots people actually swim in the sea. Here are the popular spots to swim:
--You can walk right to the shore, steps away, from PUR, and walk the beautiful, picturesque beach front
--You can swim off the docks at Rum dog, just minutes walk away, head north on the beach
-- Or you can head over to Aji Tapa Bar & Restaurant at Bella Vista Resort, our sister property and use the kayaks, swim off
host_about:
PUR Hotels are a collection of two properties in Belize. PUR Boutique Cabanas are the newest, adults-only, boutique cabanas on the tropical island of Ambergris Caye, Belize. The cabanas are a high-end, modern yet vintage, rustic-luxury experience, with a boutique hotel atmosphere, on-site full bar and Taco Bar, swim up pool bar, a mile north of the bridge.

name: Casita Teresita- A Couple's Hideaway - Beachfront
description:
Welcome!

Romantic Casita with a stunning view of the Great Barrier Reef and the Caribbean Sea. The casita is tucked among coconut palm trees on the sandy beach of Ambergris Caye. It was once a coconut grove and is a 30 mins ride on golf cart from town. The famous Secret Beach is our backyard (15 mins by golf cart).

We are Gold Standard - The Belize Tourism Board.

You may find seaweed/sargassum on the beach shoreline from seasonal shifting currents and weather patterns in the region.
neighborhood_overview: Our neighbourhood is known as Mata Grande. It's one of the most beautiful areas on the island where you will find a number of private homes and a couple small hotels/condos. Casita Teresita is on the same property of Las Amapolas. It is on a lovely beach and is calm and peaceful. Since it is on a family estate sometimes you will find family members enjoying the beach. Our closest neighbour is Captain Robby that lives with his family in the compound. The main road is easily accessible but can be bumpy at times due to pot holes. Troical Escape Grill & Bar is just a three minutes walk on the beach south of the property. They are open for breakfast, lunch and dinner and allow their patrons to swim in the pool. A few steps north is Mambo's Restaurants at Mata Chica Resorts (high end/expensive). This resort offers a day pass for a fee that enables you to use their pool. These are the closest restaurants to us. There are a few others within a ten to fifteen minutes drive or many other options
host_about:
Greetings from La Isla Bonita!

I’m an island girl that loves nature. I grew up here on Ambergris Caye in the town of San Pedro so you can call me an island expert.  Feel free to ask me any question, I will be happy to answer you. Travel and meeting people are my passion.  Between my staff and myself we will make sure that your stay with us in an enjoyable one.  Welcome to Ambergris Caye; Welcome to BELIZE.

Belize is not for everyone and it is only what you make of it.

description:
The latest addition on the Picololo property is the spot to be! Our compact cabin has everything you need for a peaceful holiday on Caye Caulker. A private & spacious porch, BIKES included, AC, fans, WiFi, kitchen, drinking water and more.
Located on our large, tree-filled property in a residential area of the island. We live on the same property with our two daughters, two dogs, and two cats. The property has five rentals that share the yard and outdoor amenities.

host_about:
We own a small vacation rental business on the island of Caye Caulker in the country of Belize. I, Hilary, am from Quebec, Canada and started spending my winters on Caye Caulker with my family when I was nine years old. I permanently moved to the island in 2001.
My husband, Pike, is from Orange Walk, a district in northern Belize. He moved to Caye Caulker for work in 1994, which is when we met and fell in love, and we got married in 2006 on Caye Caulker.
In 2007 our daughter, Lily, was born and our daughter, Ayla, was born in 2016.
I am a scuba instructor, Pike is a retired water taxi captain and we run our rental business together. 
We love to travel and enjoy having travellers stay with us. Our business is small and intimate, allowing us to ensure that your stay in Belize is authentic, creating memories for a lifetime.
Looking forward to meeting you!

My goal is to make your adventure/vacation as easy and stress less as possible. I want everyone to leave Villa Tortuga with amazing memories to last a life time. You are fortunate enough to have my friend Patojo who is a local that was born on the island and his wife Sabrina will be your on site host. Patojo is a local, dive guide and trained most of the guides on the island. He and his dad & brothers are the ones who set up the buoys at all the dive sites to tie your boat off to so the reef didn't get damaged with anchors back in the day before being environmental was cool. They also found and named all the dive sites you see on the maps. I will be off site but available anytime if needed.

neighborhood_overview:
Miramar Villas are beachfront condos on the island of Ambergris Caye, located 2.5 miles/4 km south of San Pedro’s town core, which means you are away from the crowds yet still within easy reach of everything.

Within walking distance of Miramar are a few bars/restaurants, a tour operator, and a small grocery store.

The Belize Barrier Reef, the longest in the western hemisphere, is just 1/2 mile (1 km) off shore. Sit on the beach or your veranda and you can see the waves crashing over it! The water is warm and crystal clear--ideal for scuba diving, snorkeling and fishing.

This serene stretch of the island is known for its crystal-clear waters, swaying palms, and direct access to the Belize Barrier Reef—perfect for snorkeling, kayaking, or simply soaking in the views.
